epegRNA_extension_specification.why_prime_or_cgbe_not_abe8e: c.3310C>G (g.10352442G>C) is a C:G -> G:C base transversion; adenine base editors (ABE8e) only catalyze A:T -> G:C transitions and cannot install C:G -> G:C transversions (closing AUDIT-REF). Moreover, because this + strand protospacer places 10352442G inside the 3' GGG PAM (+22), it is specifically a PEmax prime-editing guide rather than a 5'-window CGBE1 guide (closing AUDIT-REF). On the minus strand (where chr19:10352432-10352434 (-) is 5'-GGT-3' and chr19:10352436-10352438 (-) is 5'-CCA-3'), the nearest canonical 5'-NGG-3' PAMs are 5'-AGG-3' at chr19:10352422-10352424 (-) (placing 10352442C at protospacer position 3) and 5'-CGG-3' at chr19:10352433-10352435 (-) (placing 10352442C at protospacer position 14), both outside the CGBE1 nt 4-7 deamination window, so CGBE1 requires an SpG (5'-AGC-3' PAM at chr19:10352426-10352428 -, position 7) or SpRY (5'-GCC-3' PAM at chr19:10352425-10352427 -, position 6) variant (closing AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & R9-S1-L5B [DEC-074]).

representative_patient_compilations.plan_b_chr6p21_cis_deletion_hazard_and_s: On GRCh38 chr6p21.3, physical gene order is HLA-A (29.94 Mb) -> HLA-E (30.49 Mb) -> HLA-C (31.27 Mb) -> HLA-B (31.35 Mb); simultaneous DSB multiplexing of HLA-A and HLA-B is prohibited in Plan B due to the ~1.41 Mb interstitial cis-deletion/inversion risk removing intervening HLA-E and retained HLA-C. Requires sequential clonal passes or non-DSB editing plus phased HLA-A/E/C/B ddPCR and OGM verification. tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.orthogonal_protection_layers_required: Protection against TYK2-independent IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha + indirect DR3/DQ8 CD4+ autoimmunity relies on: (1) CXCL10-inducible (or L3-BF-B basal-floor) cytosolic SERPINB9 + surface PD-L1 (harnessing local IFN-gamma/STAT1 to upregulate granzyme-B/PD-1 defense), (2) peri-implant SA-FasL / SA-THBD microgel + Treg co-delivery to induce apoptosis of infiltrating Fas+ CD4+ Teff and foster FoxP3+ Treg conversion, and (3) Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic verification under combined IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha + IL-1beta + DR3/DQ8 PBMC transwell co-culture.
